description: One-step relational probe compiled to the neural ISA: role-filler pairs (fillers and one-hot role selectors) are bound with core.reasoner.roles and bundled into a query; active slots of memory.relations.slots with sim >= K - margin are hits, filtered by polarity and by the stored role count (write-time duplicates). dim, match_margin equal model/specs/reasoning.json; meta columns as in zerolm-reasoner field.
